github.label: github
github.intakeNote: issues land from a watched repository. one written here is stamped as the repo's.

gitlab.label: gitlab
gitlab.intakeNote: issues land from a watched repository. one written here is stamped as the repo's.

yandex-tracker.label: yandex tracker
yandex-tracker.intakeNote: tickets land from a watched tracker queue. one written here is stamped as the queue's.

jira.label: jira
jira.intakeNote: tickets land from a watched board. one written here is stamped as the board's.

native.label: native
native.intakeNote: written here, by a person — the product's own intake, with no tracker behind it.

intakeNoteUnknown: tickets land from a watched connection. one written here is stamped as that provider's.
nativeRefusal: native intake cannot be disconnected — it is the product's own way of accepting a ticket

watch.label: watch
watch.description: a matching ticket starts a run. nobody has to claim it.

inbox-only.label: inbox-only
inbox-only.description: a matching ticket lands in the catalog and waits for a person to take it.

both.label: both
both.description: the ticket starts a run and stays in the catalog, so the run can be found by the ticket that caused it.

note.refusedSilent: the provider refused, and said nothing useful.
note.watchOff: watch off — nothing is being admitted from here
note.matchedNothing: the filter matched nothing in the last day

registry.title: Sources
registry.failureTail: Nothing moved — the list is back as it was.
registry.sectionNote: Every source on the platform, whichever project it feeds. A connection carries the credential; its watch carries what that credential is allowed to admit — they break separately, so they read separately. Editing one is granted per project, so a row you administer sits above a row you only watch and each says which it is. native is on every project and cannot be disconnected.

connectionsPanel.emptyFiltered: No connections match the current filters.

disconnect.title: Disconnect this source?
disconnect.body: {{name}} · {{project}} — the credential is dropped and nothing more is admitted from here. Tickets already taken keep their runs; reconnecting means a new secret.

connectPage.title: Connect a source
connectPage.summary: A connection belongs to one project and carries one credential. It arrives with its watch off — admitting tickets is a separate decision, taken on the source's own page.
connectPage.tail: Nothing was saved — the details below are still exactly as you typed them.
connectPage.leaveBody: Nothing here is saved yet, and the credential you typed is not held anywhere — leaving this page drops it, and connecting later means fetching it again.

connectForm.providerCardNote: which tracker this connection watches, and whose dialect it speaks.
connectForm.providerHint: native intake is not here: every project already has one, and there is nothing to point a credential at.
connectForm.connectionCardNote: which project it feeds, where the instance is, and which credential reaches it.
connectForm.projectHint: the project this source feeds. Editing sources is granted per project, so this choice is what the save answers to.
connectForm.settingsPreview: The host stores this as a single settings json:
connectForm.probePending: test the connection before saving — an unreachable source looks exactly like a healthy one until something needs it.
connectForm.credentialCardNote: the env-var name on the host that holds the credential. The host resolves the value — the dashboard never sees it.
connectForm.secretEnvHint: the name of the env var on the host that holds the credential. The host resolves the value at probe / webhook time — the dashboard never sees it.
connectForm.mockNotice: Mock mode only: the form holds a literal credential long enough to probe the seed store. Real mode reads the env var on the host instead and never sees the value.

connectionFields.baseUrlHint: self-hosted only. https, because the credential crosses this wire.
connectionFields.accountPlaceholder: the bot or app the credential belongs to
connectionFields.accountHint: shown on the row afterwards, so a stale credential can be traced to a person.

authChoice.hint: what {{provider}} accepts, and nothing else. Stored verbatim in the settings json; never holds a credential.

connectionForm.cardNote: where the instance is, which credential reaches it, and the env-var on the host that holds it.
connectionForm.secretEnvHint: the env-var name on the host. The dashboard never sees the value; the host resolves it at probe / webhook time.
connectionForm.probePending: test the connection before saving — changing how a source is reached is not something to do while nobody knows whether it can be.

watchForm.cardNote: whether anything is admitted, which tickets, and who moves next when one is.
watchForm.watchHint: off means the connection stays authenticated and stops bringing anything in. It is not the same as disconnecting.

filterField.label: filter expression
filterField.placeholder: leave empty to admit everything this connection can see
filterField.verbatim: stored verbatim and not parsed — the filter language is not decided yet, so this text is handed to the connector exactly as it is typed.

statusPreview.head: status written back to {{provider}}
statusPreview.nativeNone: native intake is the tracker. A run's status is the ticket's status, so there is nowhere to write it back to.
statusPreview.unknownNone: nothing is written back to {{provider}} — this build has no mapping for that provider, so a run's status stays on the run.

detailPage.notFoundBody: Nothing on this platform is connected under this id. A source that was disconnected — here or in another tab — is the ordinary way to arrive at this address, and the connections list is where the ones that still exist are.
detailPage.failureTail: Nothing moved — this page is back as it was.
detailPage.credentialEnvNote: resolved on the host at probe / webhook time. The dashboard never sees the value — replacing it means changing the env var on the host and patching the connection's secretEnvRef.
detailPage.credentialStoredNote: stored write-only, and never shown again — not on this page, not in a form, not through the api. Replacing it means connecting again.
detailPage.credentialNoneNote: native intake has no remote end, so there is nothing to authenticate against.
detailPage.noWatch: Native intake has no watch. Tickets arrive here because somebody filed one, not because a filter admitted it — so there is nothing to turn on and nothing to narrow.
detailPage.rotationBody: A click generates a fresh webhook secret and shows it once. Copy it into the tracker's webhook settings — this page will not show it again.
detailPage.rotatedLabel: new webhook secret — copy now, this panel does not survive a navigation
detailPage.handoffFiled: tickets filed here. They are in the catalog with everything else —
detailPage.handoffAdmitted: tickets admitted from here. They are in the catalog with everything else —
detailPage.handoffCatalogTail: the catalog is not narrowed to this source.
detailPage.handoffProject: the project this connection feeds. Editing a source is granted per project, so this is what every act on this page answers to.
detailPage.handoffTicket: write a ticket straight into this project's intake. It is a member's act rather than an administrator's, so it has its own screen and its own permission.
detailPage.rotateBody: {{name}} · {{project}} — a new secret is generated and shown once. Webhooks signed with the previous secret will be rejected until you copy the new one into the tracker.
detailPage.leaveBody: The watch and connection details you changed on this page are not saved yet. Leaving drops them and the source stays exactly as it was.
detailPage.rotatedToastDescription: {{name}} — copy the new value into the tracker

ticketPage.title: New ticket in {{project}}
ticketPage.summary: Native intake is the product's own. A ticket written here has no tracker behind it, so its status is the run's status and there is nowhere to sync it back to.
ticketPage.notFoundBody: No connection on this platform has the id {{id}}. A source that was disconnected while this tab sat open is the ordinary way to arrive here.
ticketPage.tail: Nothing was filed — what you typed is still here.
ticketPage.leaveBody: The title, body and labels you typed are not saved anywhere yet. Leaving this page drops them, and nothing reaches intake.

ticketForm.titlePlaceholder: what is wrong, in one line
ticketForm.bodyPlaceholder: what you saw, and where. The brain reads this before it plans anything.
ticketForm.labelsHint: comma separated. These are the ticket's own labels — not a filter expression.
ticketForm.straightHint: off leaves it for somebody to claim, which is the same act a minute later.
